Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that was it from out coverage of match number 15 of the 2024 ICC T20 World Cup. In this game, it was Bangladesh who took home the win against Sri Lanks. However, the cricketing action doesn’t stop here. Join us for our coverage of match number 16 where Netherlands take on South Africa at the Nassau County Stadium in New York. The first ball will be bowled at 8.00 pm IST (2.30 pm GMT) but our coverage will start much earlier. Until then, goodbye and cheers!

Najmul Hossain Shanto, the winning captain is up for a chat. He says that he is happy with the win and that everyone gave their best. Adds that they have been preparing and practicing for the last 10-15 days. Adds that he wasn't much happy with the batting and they will try and work on that. Mentions that Litton Das getting back to fomr was a good thing and appreciates Towhid Hridoy as well. Thanks the crowd for their support.

Wanindu Hasaranga, the captain of Sri Lanka is up for a chat he says that they started well with the bat but lost their way. Adds that bowling is their strength. Reckons that if they had 150-160 runs on the board, they would have been in the game. Says that the batters let them down today. Ends by sharing that they will try to do well in the next two games. Shares that he wanted to attack with four genuine bowlers but the all-rounders were not upto the mark.

Rishad Hossain is the Player of the Match for his outstanding spell. He says that the pitch and conditions were good to bowl. Shares that he bowled to his strengths and according to the field. Adds that he tried his best on the hat-trick ball but couldn’t get it. Ends by thanking the almighty for his performance.
The Presentation ceremony…

Earlier in the innings, we saw Sri Lanka get off to a flying start and taking on the bowlers. However, Bangladesh bounced back strongly and looked lethal after the first 6 overs. They managed to stop the runs and took timely wickets. Their catching was right there at the top and they didn’t bowl many extras which helped them restrict Sri Lanka to a low score of 124. Rishad Hossain and Mustafizur Rahman were the pick of the bowlers with their 3 wickets each. Pathum Nissanka was the top scorer for Sri Lanka with 47 runs to his name.

Bangladesh had an absolute disaster for a start. Soumya Sarkar and Tanzid Hasan, their openers were sent back in the first two over itself. As Litton Das and Najmul Hossain Shanto tried to build a partnership, a sharp catch brought an end to the latter’s innings. The process of building a stand began again with Das and Towhid Hridoy. They executed the plan well and played simple cricket avoiding any risky shots. Automatically, the boundaries started coming and they managed to put some pressure on the bowlers. Towhid Hridoy took on Hasaranga and got them back in control of the game. Das also was trapped infront of the stumps by the opposition skipper. With his wicket, the batters again went back to batting cautiously. With the wickets falling at timely intervals, they started to loose their control over the game. Thushara spoiled their party in the 18th over and got the tail end out to bat. Mahmadullah acted as their saviour and secured their win. With a win in their first game of the tournament, they are off to a good start.

Sri Lanka were off to a dream start. Dhananjaya de Silva gave them a breakthrough in the first over as he sent back Soumya Sarkar. Nuwan Thushara followed it up in the next over as he castled Tanzid Hasan. He continued his lethal bowling and made Najmul Hossain Shanto as his second prey. After that, the bowlers struggled to take wickets and also bowled some loose deliveries. They also bowled a lot of extras which didn’t make the scenario better. Wanindu Hasaranga got the wicket of Towhid Hridoy and Litton Das but the batters had already dealt a lot of damage to the Lankans. However, the scoring rate decreased but the pressure remained on the Lankans. Matheesha Pathirana got the wicket of Shakib Al Hasan courtesy of a brilliant catch by Maheesh Theekshana which gave them some confidence. Thushara got two more wickets at a very crucial time as he got rid of Rishad Hossain and Taskin Ahmed. They have now both their games and in order to move up the table, Sri Lanka, cannot afford to lose any more games. They will need to work on their performance espescially in the batting department.

WOW! We have witnessed a nail-biting encounter as two rivals from Asia put up a great fight in terms of bat and ball. There were a lot of ups and downs for both teams throughout the match but in the end Bangladesh emerged victorious. Mahmadullah made sure that he stays on the crease till the last run and secured their victory. However, they will not be too happy with their batting performance but will happily take those two points in their first match of the tournament.

WHAT A FINISH! Mahmudullah takes Bangladesh home! Slower and fuller at the stumps. Mahmudullah skips down and drills it toward mid-off. The fielder has a shy at the stumps and poor backing up allows the second run. That will be it for Bangladesh as they complete two runs and win by 2 wickets with an over to spare.

OUT! TAKEN! BRILLIANT CATCH! Nuwan Thushara strikes again. He goes full and wide outside off. Najmul Hossain Shanto drives it with good timing but manages to find Charith Asalanka who was the only fielder ahead of square on the off side. Asalanka takes a sharp catch leaning to his right. That is a big wicket for Sri Lanka.
Commentary.Howout: c Charith Asalanka b Nuwan Thushara
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.2: Nuwan Thushara to Najmul Hossain Shanto, OUT! c Charith Asalanka b Nuwan Thushara.

Commentary.Commentary: Short and over off. Najmul Hossain Shanto punches it to point and is sent back by his partner.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.1: Nuwan Thushara to Najmul Hossain Shanto, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! LUCKY! Maheesh Theekshana goes flatter and fuller on off. Litton Das tries the sweep, gets the top edge and the ball flies over the keeper's head. The fielders fails to stop it from reaching the fence and that is the first boundary for Bangladesh.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.6: Maheesh Theekshana to Litton Das, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Looped full from 'round the wicket aimed at off. Najmul Hossain Shanto pushes it to covers and gets another single to his name. Good communication between the batters.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.5: Maheesh Theekshana to Najmul Hossain Shanto, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, within the stumps. Litton Das works it towards square leg for another single. That is a good plan from the batters.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.4: Maheesh Theekshana to Litton Das, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Darted it onto leg from 'round the wicket. Najmul Hossain Shanto deflects it to square leg for one run.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.3: Maheesh Theekshana to Najmul Hossain Shanto, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Even fuller now right under middle. Litton Das clips it to long on and jogs to the other end.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.2: Maheesh Theekshana to Litton Das, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Floated full, turning in towards middle. Litton Das punches it back to the bowler.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.1: Maheesh Theekshana to Litton Das, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: 135 clicks, full and on off. Najmul Hossain Shanto drives it to the fielder at mid on and refuses a single. The boundaries have not yet arrived off the bat for Bangladesh.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.6: Nuwan Thushara to Najmul Hossain Shanto, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: A low full toss on the pads. Litton Das manages to push it out in front and hurries away for one run.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.5: Nuwan Thushara to Litton Das, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: On a very good length, aimed on leg. Najmul Hossain Shanto flicks it to deep square leg for another single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.4: Nuwan Thushara to Najmul Hossain Shanto, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: A short one now on the pads. Litton Das nudges it towards deep square leg for an easy single. The batters don't seem to be taking any risks.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.3: Nuwan Thushara to Litton Das, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Lovely! Nuwan Thushara slings this one full and on middle. Najmul Hossain Shanto manages to block it out on the pitch and the batters take a quick single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.2: Nuwan Thushara to Najmul Hossain Shanto, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: On a length aimed at off. Najmul Hossain Shanto punches it to point and refuses the single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.1: Nuwan Thushara to Najmul Hossain Shanto, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Quick and full from 'round the wicket. Najmul Hossain Shanto is hit on the pads but the ball seems to be angling down leg. They cross for one in the process. Another tight over by Sri Lanka.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.6: Maheesh Theekshana to Najmul Hossain Shanto, Leg bye.

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter and quicker on middle. Litton Das clips it to mid-wicket for another run.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.5: Maheesh Theekshana to Litton Das, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Floated up on middle. Najmul Hossain Shanto flicks it to mid on for one run.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.4: Maheesh Theekshana to Najmul Hossain Shanto, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Good fielding! Maheesh Theekshana tosses it up and keeps it outside off. Litton Das creates some room for himself and slices it through point. The fielder there manages to get a hand to it and helps take some pace off from the ball. The batters run three runs as another fielder stops the ball.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.3: Maheesh Theekshana to Litton Das, 3 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: Again, full and on the sticks. Najmul Hossain Shanto whips it off his pads towards mid-wicket and sets off for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.2: Maheesh Theekshana to Najmul Hossain Shanto, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: A bit short but down the leg side. The umpire signals a wide.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.2: Maheesh Theekshana to Najmul Hossain Shanto, Wide!

Commentary.Commentary: Beaten! Quick and full outside off. Najmul Hossain Shanto tries to block it but the ball zips past it outer edge.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.1: Maheesh Theekshana to Najmul Hossain Shanto, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Good end to the over! Nuwan Thushara delivers it slow and on a length. The ball swung back away from off as Litton Das tried to bring his bat infront of it. That is a strong start from the Lankans and they are out to hunt.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.6: Nuwan Thushara to Litton Das, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Sticks to the good length around off. Najmul Hossain Shanto gets the inner edge and deflects the ball towards square leg. Gets off the mark with a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.5: Nuwan Thushara to Najmul Hossain Shanto, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Wide! Errs in line again, full and wide outside off. Najmul Hossain Shanto leaves it alone as the umpire signals a wide.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.5: Nuwan Thushara to Najmul Hossain Shanto, Wide!

Commentary.Commentary: Najmul Hossain Shanto, the skipper walks out to bat now.

OUT! CASTLED! ABSOLUTE BEAUTY! Nuwan Thushara nails this one. Full and swinging in onto off. Tanzid Hasan tries to play it through the line but the ball swings back in missing the bat. The off stump is hit and the bails are lit indicating that Sri Lanka have got another wicket. A poor start from Bangladesh as they lose two wickets in the first two overs.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.4: Nuwan Thushara to Tanzid Hasan, OUT! b Nuwan Thushara.

Commentary.Commentary: Nuwan Thushara serves it short around off. Litton Das gets on top of it and punches it towards point. The batters take another single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.3: Nuwan Thushara to Litton Das, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Quick and on the hard length, nipping back towards leg. Tanzid Hasan flicks it off towards deep square leg to run one.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.2: Nuwan Thushara to Tanzid Hasan, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Drops it short and keeps it over middle. Tanzid Hasan walks forward and guides it to the fielder at point.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.1: Nuwan Thushara to Tanzid Hasan, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Wide! Errs in line! Serves it very full but wide outside off. Tanzid Hasan leaves it alone and the umpire signals a wide.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.1: Nuwan Thushara to Tanzid Hasan, Wide!

Commentary.Commentary: Nuwan Thushara to operate from the opposite end.
Again full and on off. Tanzid Hasan punches it to mid on to run a single. A very good first over from DDS.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.6: Dhananjaya de Silva to Tanzid Hasan, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Looped full on middle. Tanzid Hasan blocks it out solidly.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.5: Dhananjaya de Silva to Tanzid Hasan, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Uppish and on middle. Litton Das clips it to mid-wicket for a single ot get off the mark.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.4: Dhananjaya de Silva to Litton Das, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Litton Das is the new batter in.

OUT! TAKEN! Dhananjaya de Silva draws first blood and very early in the innings! He bowls a half-tracker and keeps it on middle. Soumya Sarkar tries to loft it over mid on but he doesn't get hold of it. Wanindu Hasaranga runs back and takes an amazing catch. Sri Lanka are up and running.
Commentary.Howout: c Wanindu Hasaranga b Dhananjaya de Silva
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.3: Dhananjaya de Silva to Soumya Sarkar, OUT! c Wanindu Hasaranga b Dhananjaya de Silva.

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter and full angling towards leg. Soumya Sarkar goes for the sweep but gets hit on the pads. A slight appeal but the ball was sliding down the leg side.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.2: Dhananjaya de Silva to Soumya Sarkar, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Goes full and on the pads. Tanzid Hasan clips it to mid on and gets off the mark with a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.1: Dhananjaya de Silva to Tanzid Hasan, 1 run.
